001package com.streamConverter.command.impl.xml;
002
003import com.streamConverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import com.streamConverter.command.rule.IRule;
005import com.streamConverter.pathHandler.FixedStaXPathHandler;
006import java.io.IOException;
007import java.io.InputStream;
008import java.io.OutputStream;
009import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
010import java.io.Writer;
011import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
012import java.util.ArrayList;
013import java.util.List;
014import java.util.logging.Logger;
015import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventFactory;
016import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventReader;
017import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventWriter;
018import javax.xml.stream.XMLInputFactory;
019import javax.xml.stream.XMLOutputFactory;
020import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
021import javax.xml.stream.events.XMLEvent;
022
023/**
024 * XML Navigate Command Class
025 *
026 * <p>This class implements command for targeted XML transformation using XPath. It identifies
027 * specific elements using XPath expressions and applies IRule transformations to those elements
028 * while preserving the overall XML structure.
029 */
030public class XmlNavigateCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
031  private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(XmlNavigateCommand.class.getName());
032  private static final XMLEventFactory EVENT_FACTORY = XMLEventFactory.newInstance();
033
034  private String xpath;
035  private IRule rule;
036  private FixedStaXPathHandler pathHandler;
037
038  /**
039   * Constructor for XML navigation with XPath selector and transformation rule.
040   *
041   * @param xpath the XPath expression to select elements (e.g., "users/user/name")
042   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
043   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
044   */
045  public XmlNavigateCommand(String xpath, IRule rule) {
046    if (rule == null) {
047      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
048    }
049    this.xpath = xpath;
050    this.rule = rule;
051    if (xpath != null) {
052      this.pathHandler = new FixedStaXPathHandler(xpath);
053    }
054  }
055
056  /**
057   * Factory method for creating an XML navigation command with explicit rule specification. This
058   * method makes the intention explicit: extract data from the specified XPath and apply the given
059   * transformation rule.
060   *
061   * @param xpath the XPath expression to select elements (e.g., "users/user/name")
062   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
063   * @return an XmlNavigateCommand that extracts the specified XPath with the given rule
064   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
065   */
066  public static XmlNavigateCommand create(String xpath, IRule rule) {
067    return new XmlNavigateCommand(xpath, rule);
068  }
069
070  /**
071   * Factory method for creating an XML navigation command that processes entire XML with explicit
072   * rule specification. This method makes the intention explicit: process all XML data with the
073   * given transformation rule.
074   *
075   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to entire XML
076   * @return an XmlNavigateCommand that processes entire XML with the given rule
077   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
078   */
079  public static XmlNavigateCommand createForAll(IRule rule) {
080    return new XmlNavigateCommand(null, rule);
081  }
082
083  @Override
084  protected String getCommandDetails() {
085    if (xpath != null) {
086      return String.format("XmlNavigateCommand(xpath='%s')", xpath);
087    } else {
088      return "XmlNavigateCommand(entire XML)";
089    }
090  }
091
092  @Override
093  protected void executeInternal(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
094      throws IOException {
095    try (Writer writer = new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
096      if (xpath == null) {
097        // Apply rule to entire XML content
098        applyRuleToEntireXml(inputStream, writer);
099      } else {
100        // Apply rule to specific XPath elements while preserving structure
101        applyRuleToXmlPath(inputStream, writer);
102      }
103    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
104      throw new IOException("XML processing error", e);
105    }
106  }
107
108  /** Apply transformation rule to entire XML content */
109  private void applyRuleToEntireXml(InputStream inputStream, Writer writer)
110      throws IOException, XMLStreamException {
111    XMLEventReader eventReader = null;
112    XMLEventWriter eventWriter = null;
113
114    try {
115      eventReader = createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
116      eventWriter = createXMLEventWriter(writer);
117      processXmlEvents(eventReader, eventWriter, (event, data) -> rule.apply(data));
118    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
119      handleXmlException(e);
120    } finally {
121      closeResources(eventReader, eventWriter);
122    }
123  }
124
125  /**
126   * Apply transformation rule to specific XPath elements while preserving XML structure This is a
127   * simplified implementation - production version would need proper XPath library
128   */
129  private void applyRuleToXmlPath(InputStream inputStream, Writer writer)
130      throws IOException, XMLStreamException {
131    XMLEventReader eventReader = null;
132    XMLEventWriter eventWriter = null;
133
134    try {
135      eventReader = createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
136      eventWriter = createXMLEventWriter(writer);
137      navigateXmlWithRule(eventReader, eventWriter, pathHandler, rule);
138    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
139      handleXmlException(e);
140    } finally {
141      closeResources(eventReader, eventWriter);
142    }
143  }
144
145  private void navigateXmlWithRule(
146      XMLEventReader eventReader,
147      XMLEventWriter eventWriter,
148      FixedStaXPathHandler pathHandler,
149      IRule rule)
150      throws XMLStreamException {
151    List<String> currentPath = new ArrayList<>();
152    boolean inTargetElement = false;
153    int targetDepth = 0;
154
155    while (eventReader.hasNext()) {
156      XMLEvent event = eventReader.nextEvent();
157
158      if (event.isStartElement()) {
159        String elementName = event.asStartElement().getName().getLocalPart();
160        currentPath.add(elementName);
161
162        if (pathHandler.isTarget(currentPath)) {
163          inTargetElement = true;
164          targetDepth = currentPath.size();
165          eventWriter.add(event);
166        } else if (inTargetElement) {
167          eventWriter.add(event);
168        }
169      } else if (event.isEndElement()) {
170        if (inTargetElement) {
171          eventWriter.add(event);
172          if (currentPath.size() == targetDepth) {
173            inTargetElement = false;
174            // Add newline as simple characters
175            eventWriter.add(EVENT_FACTORY.createCharacters("\n"));
176          }
177        }
178        currentPath.remove(currentPath.size() - 1);
179      } else if (event.isCharacters() && inTargetElement) {
180        // Apply rule to character data in target elements
181        String originalData = event.asCharacters().getData();
182        String transformedData = rule.apply(originalData);
183        if (!originalData.equals(transformedData)) {
184          // Create new character event with transformed data
185          XMLEvent transformedEvent = EVENT_FACTORY.createCharacters(transformedData);
186          eventWriter.add(transformedEvent);
187        } else {
188          eventWriter.add(event);
189        }
190      }
191    }
192  }
193
194  // Common factory methods and utilities
195  private XMLEventReader createXMLEventReader(InputStream inputStream) throws XMLStreamException {
196    XMLInputFactory inputFactory = XMLInputFactory.newInstance();
197    XMLEventReader reader = inputFactory.createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
198    if (!reader.hasNext()) {
199      throw new XMLStreamException("Empty XML input");
200    }
201    return reader;
202  }
203
204  private XMLEventWriter createXMLEventWriter(Writer writer) throws XMLStreamException {
205    XMLOutputFactory outputFactory = XMLOutputFactory.newInstance();
206    return outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(writer);
207  }
208
209  private void handleXmlException(XMLStreamException e) throws IOException {
210    String message = e.getMessage();
211    if (message != null && (message.contains("unclosed") || message.contains("end"))) {
212      throw new IOException("Invalid XML format - unclosed tags", e);
213    }
214    throw new IOException("Invalid XML format", e);
215  }
216
217  @FunctionalInterface
218  private interface CharacterDataProcessor {
219    String process(XMLEvent event, String data);
220  }
221
222  private void processXmlEvents(
223      XMLEventReader eventReader, XMLEventWriter eventWriter, CharacterDataProcessor processor)
224      throws XMLStreamException {
225    while (eventReader.hasNext()) {
226      XMLEvent event = eventReader.nextEvent();
227
228      if (event.isCharacters()) {
229        String originalData = event.asCharacters().getData();
230        String transformedData = processor.process(event, originalData);
231
232        if (!originalData.equals(transformedData)) {
233          XMLEvent transformedEvent = EVENT_FACTORY.createCharacters(transformedData);
234          eventWriter.add(transformedEvent);
235        } else {
236          eventWriter.add(event);
237        }
238      } else {
239        eventWriter.add(event);
240      }
241    }
242    eventWriter.flush();
243  }
244
245  private void closeResources(XMLEventReader eventReader, XMLEventWriter eventWriter) {
246    if (eventReader != null) {
247      try {
248        eventReader.close();
249      } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
250        LOGGER.warning("Failed to close XMLEventReader: " + e.getMessage());
251      }
252    }
253    if (eventWriter != null) {
254      try {
255        eventWriter.close();
256      } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
257        LOGGER.warning("Failed to close XMLEventWriter: " + e.getMessage());
258      }
259    }
260  }
261}
